generic_domain.justification: Environmental Policy is a broad field that addresses how governments and organizations formulate and implement strategies to protect the environment. It encompasses various areas like environmental sustainability, regulations, resource management, and pollution control. Environmental policies can also encompass actions aimed at promoting sustainable development and mitigating climate change. This domain provides a comprehensive framework for understanding and addressing environmental issues at multiple levels (local, national, international). Therefore, it is more general than environmental sustainability as it includes not just the sustainable practices but also the policy-making processes that guide them.
